resolution.reason: Increase the common grid step only as needed to fit the full supported source-floor bounds within the cell budget. Exact interior triangles still govern movement and floor height.

metadata.limitations: One supported floor layer per X/Z; unsafe deep wells stay visible but are not walkable. Exact interior support triangles prevent invented ramps over sill/well discontinuities.
